dataNotice: 仅用于测试框架，分数不代表真实水平。Framework test data only: the essays are short texts written for this repository and the bands are invented; they do not represent real IELTS writing levels.

samples.taskPrompt: The chart shows weekly homework hours for three age groups of students in 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features.
The graph shows how many people used buses, trains and cars in one town in 2010 and 2020. Summarise the main features.
Some people think mobile phones do more harm than good. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many cities build more roads to reduce traffic. Is this the best solution? Give your opinion.
Some people believe university education should be free for everyone. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Remote work is said to weaken teamwork. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Sport is important for everyone. What are the advantages and disadvantages of doing sport?
Advertising aimed at children should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
